narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the specific functions of skincare ingredients (humectants and occlusives) and to debunk the myth that everyone needs 'occlusive' (moisture-locking) products, particularly advising those with naturally oily skin to avoid them to prevent damage to the skin barrier. It serves to establish professional authority for the clinic.
